hard_failures_note: No HF-01..HF-14 is established against A0 as an artifact: A0 is the rubric that defines the HF taxonomy, it is not itself a claim record. The four adjudicated findings below are artifact defects at the pin and are the reason the verdict is revise, not accept.

prior_findings_adjudication.finding: HF-01 conformance reads claim.artifact_refs which is absent from ledger rows
prior_findings_adjudication.why: A0:174 still keys the critical detector on claim.artifact_refs (`claim.conclusion_type == theorem AND (no artifact_refs OR artifact missing OR hash mismatch)`). The field artifact_refs is defined only for claim events in comms/PROTOCOL.md:24 and schemas.py:55-56. Read-only census of ledger/theorems.jsonl: 62 rows, 0 carry any artifact_refs key (or any key containing 'artifact'), while 30 of the 62 declare conclusion_type == theorem (first at line 7 T-101, last at line 62 T-529). The audit implementation applies HF-01 to exactly those rows (artifacts/audit/audit_lib.py:189-191) because audit_run.py:216 scans `ledger` by default, so at this pin the detector emits 30 critical HF-01 violations that cannot be cleared without either adding a field the ledger schema does not define or changing the ledger's conclusion_type vocabulary. A0 never states which record type `claim` denotes, so the criterion is not decidable as written and the G-AUDIT metric at A0:149 (hard_failure_rate <= 0.10) is computed over systematic false criticals.
prior_findings_adjudication.remedy: State the record scope of HF-01 explicitly and align the field name with the ledger schema (e.g. apply HF-01 only to map claim events, which do carry artifact_refs in 223/269 records, and give the theorem ledger its own detector keyed on its actual support fields), or add artifact_refs to the ledger row schema and repin.

prior_findings_adjudication.why: A0:128 admits exactly {comeager, full_measure, open_dense, codim_ge_1, non_generic_excluded}. The frozen class schemas declare the canonical token residual_comeager (schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml:141, schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml:156, schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml:158). The external alias map artifacts/formulation/VOCAB_ALIASES.json (owner astra-lead-formulation, created 2026-09-11T23:32:53) maps canonical residual_comeager to aliases [baire_residual, provisional_baire_residual, residual, comeager]; the mapping runs canonical -> alias, so an artifact carrying the frozen canonical value still fails A0's literal enum, and A0 does not cite the alias file anywhere. The mismatch is wider than one token: canonical open_dense_escape vs A0 open_dense, canonical finite_codimension_complement vs A0 codim_ge_1, canonical none vs A0 non_generic_excluded, and codim_ge_1 / non_generic_excluded have no entry at all in VOCAB_ALIASES.json. schemas/f1_falsifier_tests.jsonl:10 (F1-AMB-10) records exactly this cross-artifact vocabulary conflict and resolves it only through the alias file, which A0 does not bind.
prior_findings_adjudication.remedy: Import the canonical vocabulary by reference (cite artifacts/formulation/VOCAB_ALIASES.json with sha256), enumerate the canonical tokens, and state the alias policy for consistency checks; do not keep a second enum in A0.

prior_findings_adjudication.finding: conclusion_primary=future_asymptotic_predictability promotes an equivalence F1 marks UNVERIFIED
prior_findings_adjudication.why: A0:63-64 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) and A0:113-114 (AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH) promote conclusion_primary future_asymptotic_predictability together with conclusion_implied [completeness_of_I_plus, no_naked_singularity_from_I_plus], and A0:129-130 requires that implied conclusions carry an implication note. Neither WCC entry has one (only AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN does, A0:85). F1 at schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml:248 marks the equivalent-standard-formulation leaf `status: "claimed equivalence, UNVERIFIED; the class is bound to statement_formal"`, line 311 registers the prediction/predictability relation as unresolved, line 316 lists 'equivalence with future asymptotic predictability', and line 323 lists 'the equivalence to future asymptotic predictability is UNVERIFIED'. A gate run keyed to A0 as written would therefore bless an implied conclusion that F1 itself records as unverified, and would do so while omitting the implication note A0 demands of everyone else.
prior_findings_adjudication.remedy: Add an explicit implication_note to both WCC classes recording that the completeness-of-I+/no-naked-singularity equivalence is UNVERIFIED and owned by L1, and make G-FORM (A0:129-130) fail an implied conclusion whose equivalence leaf is UNVERIFIED; alternatively drop conclusion_implied for these classes until L1 verifies it.

prior_findings_adjudication.why: A0:48-50 still carry last_run: null, last_run_result: null, report_sha256: null, next to the comment at A0:46 'a rubric with no passing self-test is not a gate'. audit_run.py:180-185 emits an artifact event for A0 with validation_status derived from the run, but never writes the validation block (a grep for `last_run` in audit_run.py returns no write site), so even external run reports under artifacts/audit/reports/ are not bound to the pinned bytes. At this pin A0 declares its own required self-test unrun.
prior_findings_adjudication.remedy: Run artifacts/audit/audit_run.py against the pinned rubric, record last_run / last_run_result / report_sha256 before the next freeze, and have the artifact event carry the report sha256; a rubric whose self-test is unrun must not be proposed for a pass verdict.

findings.field: verifiers.<task>.checks vs gates.<id>.criteria (binding list not stated)
findings.finding: The two lists a linter can key on diverge and A0 never says which is binding. schema_formulation.checks (A0:20-22) require topology block, weighted data class, genericity kind + topology, I+/visibility role by family, extension regularity xor, falsifier tiering and non-vacuity; the G-FORM criteria (A0:125-133) do not mention I+/visibility role, extension regularity xor, non-vacuity, falsifier tiering or the genericity topology, while they add 'artifact exists and sha256 recorded' (A0:133) which the verifier checks omit. Same drift for numerics: 'seeds recorded' is a verifier check (A0:36) but not a G-NUM criterion, and 'G-FORM and G-AUDIT passed' is a G-NUM criterion (A0:158) but not a verifier check. Two careful readers can pass and fail the same F1/N0 artifact at this pin.
findings.remedy: State which list is binding (or that criteria are derived from checks) and make the two lists differ only by explicitly declared gate-level preconditions.

findings.finding: A0:283 defines novel_accepted_coverage as 'number of frozen classes with >=1 newly accepted artifact / 4', hard-coding the denominator while the class list is the source of truth at A0:55/69/86/105 (4 classes today). Any add/remove of a frozen class silently misreports coverage with no failing check.
findings.remedy: Define the denominator as the cardinality of frozen_classes (len(frozen_classes)) rather than the literal 4.

class_leakage.evidence: A0 defines exactly four class ids (A0:55, 69, 86, 105); G-FORM requires exactly one class_id from frozen_classes (A0:125); HF-02 (A0:175-179) forbids unknown class ids, disjunctions and class-disallowed conclusions. The only C0/C2 co-occurrence is the directional implication C0 => C2 with an explicit note (A0:82-85, 95); no statement disjoins them and no C2 content is admitted into the C0 entry. Read-only grep over A0: only the four frozen ids appear.

conclusion_inflation.evidence: Finding A0-089-C / prior-(c): both WCC classes promote completeness_of_I_plus and no_naked_singularity_from_I_plus as implied conclusions while F1 marks the underlying equivalence UNVERIFIED (schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml:248, 311, 316, 323), and the implication note A0:129-130 requires is absent from both entries (A0:63-64, 113-114). This is precisely the promotion path HF-02/HF-14 exist to stop.

assumption_completeness.evidence: Every frozen class carries a forbidden_evidence list (A0:65-68, 79-84, 96-99, 115-118) and HF-06 (A0:195-199) covers assumption smuggling; the C0 status_risk block (A0:100-104) honestly records the Dafermos-Luk open-set caveat. The residual gap is the unverified equivalence of finding A0-089-C, whose hypotheses are not recorded anywhere in A0; no class axis value is contradicted at this pin.

decidable_falsifier.evidence: A0 requires a finite, checkable falsifier in the stated topology (A0:131) and defines 14 binary hard-failure detectors (A0:170-252). Two detector-level defects make conformance not decidable as written: HF-01 keys on a field absent from all 62 ledger rows including the 30 theorem rows (finding A0-089-A), and A0's own validation run is null (finding A0-089-D).

fields_two_readers_disagree_on.evidence: A0-089-A (which record type HF-01 governs, and the field name), A0-089-B (genericity enum vs the canonical frozen token set and the unbound alias map), A0-089-E (verifier checks vs gate criteria as the binding list), A0-089-F (hard-coded /4 vs frozen_classes cardinality). None of these is a physics claim; all are record/precision defects.
